choices.content: Cuts all lines perpendicular to the \(x\)-axis
Cuts all circles whose center is at the origin

solutions.explanation:
A point on the \(x\)-axis has \(y=0\), so look for an input whose logarithm is zero. For any valid logarithm base \(a>0\), \(a\ne1\), we have \(a^0=1\). Therefore
\[
\log_a1=0.
\]
The graph passes through \((1,0)\), so it cuts the \(x\)-axis. Its real domain is \(x>0\), which also shows why it cannot cut the \(y\)-axis or every vertical line. The answer is choice C.
